metadata_summary.title: Heap based buffer overflow while parsing crafted X.509 certificates
metadata_summary.validation_notes: Strict reproduction succeeded on wolfSSL v4.2.0-stable commit 48c4b2fedcee4d61b6a76c5ce9e33ab212d6ab4a using the original crafted certificate. The crash requires ASan/UBSan extra build configuration with --enable-opensslextra, --enable-certgen, --enable-certreq, --enable-certext, and --enable-dtls. wolfSSL v4.3.0-stable safely rejects the input and is treated as the fixed release candidate. Current wolfSSL commit eeab53205ab57451778f7a76aad25f5349547ce5 also safely rejects the input. Candidate commit 88bf5d967 was tested but remained vulnerable.

metadata_summary.title: wolfSSL 3.10.2 X.509 certificate text parsing off-by-one
metadata_summary.trigger_behavior: X.509 certificate text parsing off-by-one out-of-bounds byte overwrite
metadata_summary.validation_notes: Strict reproduction succeeded on wolfSSL v3.10.2-stable using a reconstructed certificate generated from the public Exploit-DB/Talos PoC OpenSSL command. The input is not the original attached certificate bytes, but it preserves the published trigger structure and reproduces the reported ASan stack-buffer-overflow in wolfSSL_X509_NAME_get_text_by_NID. Fixed release candidate verified: wolfSSL v3.11.0-stable does not reproduce the ASan stack-buffer-overflow observed on v3.10.2-stable under the same minimal certfields harness and ASan/UBSan configuration. The first build attempt failed because -Werror promoted compiler warnings to errors; after removing -Werror from Makefile, the library built successfully. These build warnings are unrelated to the CVE-2017-2800 runtime PoC behavior. Current wolfSSL v5.9.1-stable-1299-geeab53205 commit eeab53205ab57451778f7a76aad25f5349547ce5 was tested with the same reconstructed CVE-2017-2800 certificate and minimal certfields harness under ASan/UBSan. No ASan stack-buffer-overflow, WRITE of size 1, or abort was observed.

metadata_summary.title: wolfSSL X.509 date buffer overflow in wolfSSL_X509_notAfter / wolfSSL_X509_notBefore
metadata_summary.validation_notes: API-level strict reproduction succeeded on wolfSSL v5.9.0-stable commit 922d04b3568c6428a9fb905ddee3ef5a68db3108 using a crafted WOLFSSL_ASN1_TIME object following PR 10071's official test pattern. Both notAfter and notBefore paths triggered ASan heap-buffer-overflow with WRITE of size 255. Fixed release candidate verified: wolfSSL v5.9.1-stable commit 1d363f3adceba9d1478230ede476a37b0dcdef24 rejects the oversized ASN1_TIME length in both notAfter and notBefore paths without sanitizer crash evidence. Current wolfSSL v5.9.1-stable-1373-g8fca95ce6 commit 8fca95ce651d6e370d91f5598786de4bc66aa2c2 was tested with the same API-level X.509 date harness. Both notAfter and notBefore paths safely rejected the oversized ASN1_TIME length without sanitizer crash evidence.

metadata_summary.title: wolfSSL CertFromX509 AuthorityKeyIdentifier size confusion heap-buffer-overflow
metadata_summary.validation_notes: Certificate-level strict reproduction succeeded on wolfSSL v5.9.0-stable commit 922d04b3568c6428a9fb905ddee3ef5a68db3108. The reconstructed DER certificate uses a small 20-byte AuthorityKeyIdentifier keyIdentifier and an oversized full AKID source of approximately 20046 bytes. The vulnerable code checks authKeyIdSz but copies authKeyIdSrcSz into cert->akid, producing ASan heap-buffer-overflow in CertFromX509. Fixed release candidate verified: wolfSSL v5.9.1-stable commit 1d363f3adceba9d1478230ede476a37b0dcdef24 safely rejects the oversized AuthorityKeyIdentifier input without sanitizer crash evidence. Current wolfSSL v5.9.1-stable-1373-g8fca95ce6 commit 8fca95ce651d6e370d91f5598786de4bc66aa2c2 was tested with the same reconstructed oversized AuthorityKeyIdentifier DER certificate. It safely rejected the input without sanitizer crash evidence.

metadata_summary.title: wolfSSL DTLS 1.3 ACK message processing heap-buffer-overflow
metadata_summary.trigger_behavior: DTLS 1.3 ACK record processing heap buffer overflow
metadata_summary.validation_notes: Selected from official wolfSSL 2026 vulnerability list. CVE-2026-5264 is a DTLS 1.3 ACK message processing heap-buffer-overflow. PR #10076 adds ACK record count bounds, seenRecordsCount tracking, and DTLS 1.3 ACK overflow tests. Candidate should be reproduced through DTLS 1.3 ACK handling path, preferably using official PR test pattern. Vulnerable reproduction confirmed on wolfSSL v5.9.0-stable: 4097 DTLS 1.3 ACK records trigger ASan out-of-bounds write in c64toa via Dtls13WriteAckMessage. Fixed/current validation pending. Fixed release verified on wolfSSL v5.9.1-stable: 4097 attempted ACK records are bounded to seenRecordsCount 128 and Dtls13WriteAckMessage completes without ASan crash. Version matrix complete: vulnerable v5.9.0-stable reproduces ASan out-of-bounds heap write in Dtls13WriteAckMessage; fixed v5.9.1-stable and current wolfSSL safely bound seenRecordsCount to 128 and complete without sanitizer evidence.
